''See also: [[Calder Marten Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] is a [[Navigator]] Captain within the [[Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Guild of Navigators]] and the commander of the ship known as [[The Testament]]. A former member of the [[Blackwatch]], he has a history marked by legal troubles, including being tried for theft, sabotage, conspiracy to commit fraud, and the destruction of [[Imperial]] property. These actions resulted in a sentence of forced labor for the [[Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild]]. Despite his reputation as a reckless and impulsive individual, he has demonstrated significant persistence and leadership. His political role expanded significantly when he was appointed as the [[Imperial Steward]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. In this capacity, he acted as a caretaker and protector for the people while sitting on the throne during a period of transition. His tenure as Steward involved managing various [[Guilds]], overseeing the dissolution of the [[Champion’s Guild{{!}}Champion's Guild]], and attempting to maintain stability amidst threats from [[Great Elders]]. Throughout his journey, he has been involved in high-stakes conflicts, including the unearthing of a [[Heart of Nakothi]] and various confrontations with [[Imperial]] authorities and other powerful entities.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] is a twenty-six-year-old man with a young face and a short, red beard. He has been seen wearing a blue jacket, a three-cornered hat, and a dark blue coat with [[Navigator]] crest buttons, as well as a suit of pure white armor with a darkened glass visor. He also utilizes an unloaded musket as a crutch and carries various weapons, including an orange-stained [[cutlass]] and an orange-and-black sword.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|His intent is characterized by passion, ambition, satisfaction, and the itch of still-healing wounds. He is a leader who has realized the necessity of leaving and has been described as a novice Emperor.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|He is the son of [[Rojric]] and [[Alsa Grayweather]], receiving basic sword training from his father and advanced dueling instruction from his mother. He was a thirteen-year-old pupil of [[Artur Belfry]] and is married to [[Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine]], a member of the [[Sleepless]]. [[Calder]] is one of [[Cheska Bennett{{!}}Cheska]]'s Navigators, has been associated with [[Shera]], and carries a mark from [[Kelarac]]. He is also connected to [[Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius]], [[Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel]], [[Lucan]], [[Petal]], and [[Estyr Six]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Reader of Memory]], [[Calder]] uses [[Intent]] to summon [[Elderspawn]] and can utilize [[Emperor’s Intent{{!}}the Emperor's Intent]]. He is a [[Navigator]] who can move his ship through consciousness, invest wood into his vessel, and control the ship as part of his own body. Additionally, he has used the [[Optasia]] to project his consciousness.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Service in the Guild}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|After being sentenced to forced labor within the [[Navigator’s Guild]], [[Calder]] [[Marten]] has spent five years in their service.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" /><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 17</ref> He is dressed in a dark blue coat featuring buttons with the [[Navigator]] crest and wears a three-cornered hat.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" /> [[Calder]] received basic sword training from his father and advanced instruction from his mother.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" /> He owns a ship named [[The Testament]] and carries a debt to the throne resulting from a daring rescue plan.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" /> Throughout his experiences, he has fought various foes including [[Elderspawn]], cultists, rebels, [[Consultant assassins]], [[Imperial Guards]], and [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref> As a [[Navigator]] aboard his ship, he is currently part of a crew headed into lethal danger with plans to detonate charges in an arena.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref> [[Calder]] is a person who has been attempting to stretch time as much as possible.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] was sentenced to forced labor in the service of the [[Navigator’s Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] is wearing a three-cornered hat and a dark blue coat.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]]'s coat buttons feature the [[Navigator]] crest.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] has spent five years in a [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] received basic sword training from his father and advanced instruction from his mother.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] has a ship named [[The Testament]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] has a debt to the throne caused by a daring rescue plan.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] has fought [[Elderspawn]], cultists, rebels, [[Consultant assassins]], [[Imperial Guards]], and [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] is part of a crew planning to detonate charges in an arena.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]] is a [[Navigator]] aboard his ship.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] is part of a crew headed into lethal danger.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder Marten]] is a person who has been trying to stretch time as much as possible.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] is driven by a complex blend of passion, ambition, and satisfaction.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 13</ref> His internal state is further defined by the persistent itch of wounds that are still healing.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder Marten]]'s intent is described as passion, ambition, satisfaction, and the itch of still-healing wounds.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Consultant saboteur}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] serves as a [[Consultant]] saboteur who was chosen by [[Lucan]] to conduct a private meeting.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 17</ref> Currently leading the attack against the [[Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild]], he is known as the individual who once tore through with the Emperor's crown.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> Having been with [[Shera]], he is described as a novice Emperor who has finally found himself a real sword.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder Marten]] is a [[Consultant]] saboteur.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Lucan]] elected to meet with [[Calder Marten]] alone.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder Marten]] is leading the [[Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild]] attack.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder Marten]] is a person who once tore through with the Emperor's crown.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder Marten]] is referred to as a novice Emperor who has 'found himself a real sword'.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder Marten]] is a character who has been with [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Emperor in white armor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] is a spawn of [[Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut]] who possesses a short, red beard and a young face.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 1</ref> He is clad in a suit of pure white armor that covers him from the neck down, featuring a helmet with a visor made of darkened glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref> While serving as a crew member of [[The Reliable]], he lent [[Petal]] a tiny spyglass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> [[Calder]] utilizes [[Emperor’s Intent{{!}}the Emperor's Intent]] and has had his consciousness projected through the [[Optasia]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]] wore a suit of pure white armor that covered him from head to toe.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]]'s helmet visor was covered by what looked like darkened glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]] is a spawn of [[Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]] has a young face and a short, red beard.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]] wears the [[Emperor's armor{{!}}Emperor's white armor]] from the neck down.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten{{!}}Captain Calder]] lent [[Petal]] a tiny spyglass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]] uses [[Emperor’s Intent{{!}}the Emperor's Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]]'s consciousness was projected through the [[Optasia]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder Marten]] is a crew member of [[The Reliable]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Participant in the debate}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a leader who insists on attending meetings, [[Calder]] [[Marten]] participates in the debate where he may receive an endorsement for Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> Mentioned by [[Estyr Six]], [[Marten]] has faced accusations of consorting with [[Kelarac]], whom he is considered a pawn of.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> After nearly being burned, he released a statement regarding an address to the Capital, though he utilized a [[body double]] wearing the [[Emperor's clothes]] instead of his own white armor to speak to the public.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" /> While he was seen chatting with [[Imperial Guards]], the man previously thought to be dead emerged as a pretender to the throne wearing the [[Emperor's armor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> [[Marten]] claims to have spoken to the man in the sky, and [[Estyr]] has noted she would kill him if he stepped out of line.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> He possesses a ship with a bound humanoid fish-creature and has held an orange Awakened blade.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">16</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] is a leader who will insist on being at the meeting.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] is a participant in the debate and may be endorsed as Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] is a character mentioned by [[Estyr Six]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] has been accused of consorting with [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] was almost burned.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] is a pawn of [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] released a statement saying he would address the Capital.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] uses a [[body double]] to address the public.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[body double]] wears the [[Emperor's clothes{{!}}Emperor’s clothes]] but not [[Calder]]'s white armor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] was seen sitting and chatting with [[Imperial Guards]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] is the pretender to the throne and wears the [[Emperor's armor{{!}}Emperor’s armor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] was thought to be dead.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] claims to have spoken to the man in the sky.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] mentioned she would kill [[Calder Marten]] if he got out of line.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] has a ship with a humanoid fish-creature bound to it.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder Marten]] held an orange Awakened blade.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Yes, ma’am. This is my son Calder, ma’am.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“So you come to me again, Reader of Memory,” Kelarac said.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Twenty-six years old, former Blackwatch, once indicted for the destruction of an entire Imperial Prison.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“A spawn of Urg’naut,” Calder Marten explained.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“We need you to endorse Calder Marten as Emperor. We will support the governors. If we fall apart in the end, so be it, but we must first give the unified Empire a chance.”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}
